mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the Rank IC for UNRATE and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the Rank IC for RSAFS and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the Rank IC for INDPRO and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it indicates a tight labor market with potential inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the Rank IC for the interaction of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE with SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% year-over-year signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the Rank IC for HOUST and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the Rank IC for PAYEMS and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points within a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
